title: Foundational Learning Gaps in Bangladesh
deck: Why so many students reach university without solid reading and maths, and why so many come to fear maths.
desc: Planned study of gaps in foundational reading and numeracy that persist into university, combining a short skills assessment, a validated maths-anxiety scale, schooling-history questions and interviews. Design in progress.
methods: Skills assessment, maths-anxiety scale, survey, semi-structured interviews

title: The Vanishing Struggle
deck: Whether generative AI substitution forecloses the occasions for reasoning in undergraduate writing.
desc: A cross-disciplinary, within-person study comparing 30–40 ULAB undergraduates across no-AI and AI-permitted writing sessions. Using version history, reflection logs, and interviews, the study measures the presence or absence of 'productive struggle' events. Proposal stage; no data collected yet.
methods: Within-person writing sessions, document version history, reflection logs, semi-structured interviews
imageAlt: Research project visual for The Vanishing Struggle, on AI-assisted academic writing and student development.

title: Algorithmic News Feeds and Misinformation Susceptibility
deck: How algorithmically ranked feeds shape what young urban news consumers trust, doubt, and share.
desc: A cross-sectional mixed-methods study proposing to survey 300–360 students across six Dhaka universities, measuring Facebook, TikTok, and AI-mediated news exposure against misinformation discernment, share intent, media-literacy training, and socioeconomic controls. Pilot responses collected; analysis in progress.
methods: MIST-20, adapted AOT, Bangladesh headline task, share-intent ratings, 18 interviews
imageAlt: Research project visual on algorithmic news feeds and misinformation susceptibility in Bangladesh.
